# CatalogEntry's fields ARE read, by a marshaller unwired cannot see.
# `gibson-runner --list-tools` does json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(
# registry.Catalog()), and the Gibson daemon's catalog refresher ingests that
# array to populate ComponentRegistry entries. Every field carries a json tag
# and reflection reads it, so there is no per-declaration read to find.
# Deleting any of them would silently drop a column from the daemon's catalog.
